$comment: skyphusion-monitor probe inventory (monitor#42). Adding/changing a surface is an edit HERE (validated in CI by tests/config.test.ts, shipped by the tagged deploy) -- never a src/ edit. Schema: src/validate.ts CheckConfig. Inventory grounded in the live CF API pull + anonymous probes 2026-07-18: worker custom domains, Access apps, DNS. Deliberately absent: monitor.skyphusion.org (self-probe is circular; internal Gatus polls /health), hooks-* doorbell endpoints (crew-bus delivery accounting owns that signal; transport rethink crew-bus#40), imap./smtp. (TCP, fleet Gatus lane), rockenhaus.org (parked zone, no live surface). VANTAGE LIMIT, MEASURED not inferred (fc#1194, 2026-08-01): this Worker CANNOT probe any *.workers.dev hostname. Cloudflare blocks Worker-to-workers.dev subrequests inside the same account and answers 404 `error code: 1042` for every such name, ENABLED and DISABLED alike -- verified against sidvicious-search/slate-search/slate-logs (all enabled, 401/405/401 from outside) and grid-hub/vivijure-studio (both disabled), with https://skyphusion.org/ as a control returning a real 200 through the same code path. The five workers.dev-targeted probes that used to live here (F1.vivijure-workersdev.cast, F1.vivijure-workersdev.modules, F1.grid-hub-workersdev, F1.prism-workersdev, AUTH.email-inbound.messages) therefore matched their expected 404 forever and could not report the bad state on any Worker. They are REPLACED by the COVER.workers-dev check, which reads authoritative state from the Cloudflare API for EVERY Worker in the account (see workersDev below and src/coverage.ts). Custom-domain probes are unaffected: the control proves a Worker-to-Worker fetch over a custom domain returns the real status. Also removed at fc#1194: the common-thread-web and common-thread-backend uptime checks. common-thread was SHELVED 2026-07-31 and all three custom domains were removed, so both hostnames are NXDOMAIN (verified by getent + curl, independently of the monitor) and both checks had become permanent guaranteed failures -- alert noise that would mask a real outage. Restore them if common-thread comes off the shelf; the Workers, DO state, Hyperdrive and R2 bucket were left intact.

workersDev.$comment: ALLOWANCE policy for the COVER.workers-dev check (fc#1194 / fc#1180 F2). The Worker LIST is derived from the Cloudflare API at runtime, never from this file -- a Worker deployed tomorrow is assessed the moment it exists, and a Worker nobody remembers is assessed too. This list is only the set of Workers permitted to answer on *.workers.dev. Rules enforced by src/coverage.ts: an ENABLED Worker with no entry FAILS; an entry whose Worker is no longer enabled FAILS (a stale allowance must not rot into a permanent silent pass); an entry naming a Worker that does not exist FAILS; a zero-length enumeration FAILS (an empty success is indistinguishable from a permission gap, fc#1180 F5); a non-boolean previews_enabled FAILS as UNKNOWN. An entry here RECORDS an exposure, it does not bless it: workers.dev is not covered by Cloudflare Access, which binds a hostname, so each of these depends on the Worker's own code staying correct forever with no platform gate behind it. Disabling any of these live hostnames is Conrad-gated (fc#1180 F1 precedent: unknown dependants).
